posts.name: Nadeem Khan
posts.cooked:
Hi Team,

I missed the BPT 3 assignment by 2 days , i was under the impression that the deadline is 29th while the deadline was 27th. Since the OPPE eligbility is reliant on BPT avg >= 40 and BPT-4 is not considered I have no way to be eligible for OPPE this term. My GA avg is good and I am elgible for final exams. MY question is since I will be repeating OPPE only in the next term ( although I would request the admins to reconsider the OPPE eligibility for system commands – as the whole BPT thing is not properly visible in the course page) Can I opt for 4 new courses and 1 OPPE repeat, since its just OPPE.

Please help with the clarification. Also requesting admins to keep all deadlines on Sundays as many of us are working professionals and it very hard to submit the assignments on working days.

Thanks,

Nadeem

posts.name: Vinay Maurya
posts.cooked: If you have combined score of bpt1 and bpt2 > 120 then I think you are eligible for oppe

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
24f1002464:

Can I opt for 4 new courses and 1 OPPE repeat, since its just OPPE.

No you cannot do that.

posts.name: Nadeem Khan
posts.cooked: bpt 1 is marked as absent. I was late then too. I want to know when repeating only oppe carried over to next term can i opt for 4 new courses or since 3 + 1 oppe

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
You cannot do 4 theo courses + 1 repeat oppe.

You can do:

3 theo + 1 repeat oppe

3 theo + 1 repeat oppe + any no. of projects
